The '''Imperial Governor's Estate''' was the official residence the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]], the capital world of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The building was located on [[Estalle Island]] but was not as imposing as the [[Imperial Moff's Estate]] that was also in the Residential District of the island. Unlike the Moff, the governor's offices were in the Historical District of Estalle Island.
